name: Atikin SEO
author: Atikin Verse

sections.description:
Atikin SEO is a fast, privacy-friendly plugin that helps you auto-optimize your website with clean meta tags, social previews, and more. Built for simplicity and speed, with no bloat.

Usage

After activating the plugin:
1. Go to “Atikin SEO” in the dashboard.
2. Review or update meta title and description.
3. Sitemap will be automatically generated in the background.

Credits

Created by Atikin Verse.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Atikin SEO from the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Atikin SEO is very lightweight and optimized for performance.

Will it generate a sitemap?

Yes, Atikin SEO generates a sitemap to help search engines index your pages.
